newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico February industrial activity rose 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico February industrial activity rose 8.2 pct.

text.p: Mexico's industrial activity rose 8.2 pct in February compared to the same month last year, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday in a statement.
The rise meant that industrial activity in the first two months of the year rose 7.7 percent against the same period a year earlier, the ministry added.
February showed the 14th consecutive month of positive growth in industrial output as Mexico climbed out of its 1995 recession.
